o.text:
Borrowed from Turkish anlam, which is a nonsemantic learned borrowing from Karachay-Balkar анъылам (aꞑılam, “understanding; feeling; intelligence”). See the Turkish word for details.
Compare Azerbaijani qafa, another nonsemantic borrowing (from Arabic).
Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish دَكْ (däŋ), from Proto-Turkic *teŋ (“equal”).
